features: Power‐Packed Dimensity 8450 4nm Processor: Built on advanced 4‐nanometer process with peak 3.25GHz octa‐core performance, paired with LPDDR5X RAM and UFS 3.1 storage. Deliver smooth gaming, multi‐tasking and fast app loading, with optimized power efficiency for all‐day heavy‐usage scenarios.

Versatile Triple Rear Camera System with OIS: Featuring 200MP main sensor with 2‐axis OIS, 50MP 3.5X periscope telephoto lens(OIS) and 50MP 116° ultra‐wide camera. Capture sharp low‐light shots, portrait zoom and wide‐angle landscapes; support up to 4K 60fps video recording. 50MP AF front camera delivers crisp self‐portraits for social media content creation.

6.78‐inch 1.5K LTPO AMOLED Display: Adaptive 1‐120Hz smart refresh rate, 10‐bit 1.07‐billion‐color panel, peak local brightness up to 3600 nits. Equipped with Corning Gorilla Glass Victus 2 for scratch‐resistance; 2160Hz high‐frequency PWM dimming reduces eye strain during long‐time reading and video streaming.

6500mAh Large Battery | 80W SUPERVOOC + 50W AirVOOC Wireless Charging: Massive 6500mAh lithium‐polymer battery. 80W wired flash charging for speedy top‐ups, plus 50W AirVOOC wireless fast charging for cable‐free convenient power replenishment for daily entertainment, gaming and work.

ColorOS 16 based on Android 16 & Premium Build: Run ColorOS 16 with rich AI‐driven smart features for smarter life assistance. Dual‐SIM 5G ready, IP69K dust‐and‐water resistant, complete with NFC and stereo speakers. Sleek lightweight body fits comfortably in‐hand for long‐hour daily use.
